Guest Photo Gallery & Digital Guestbook For Your Celebration​

EVENT PHOTO COLLECTION MADE EASY
Capture every moment so you don't miss a thing!
Celebrations are special moments to relish forever. From birthday parties and decade reaching milestones, to baby showers and religious ceremonies. Cherish these magic moments forever.

Loved & Used For...

MILESTONE BIRTHDAYS
CHILDRENS BIRTHDAYS
QUINCEANERA
BAR MITZVAH
RETIREMENT PARTY
GRADUATION PARTY
BABY SHOWER
GOING AWAY PARTIES

Instantly collect the best moments from your guests in your celebration gallery.

No App. No Fuss.

  • PHOTO
  • VIDEOS
  • GUESTBOOK
How It works
See your event through the eyes of your guests and re-live it all over again.

Enjoy The Best Memories In Your Celebration Gallery

You’ll love seeing the best moments from your guests appear live in your digital gallery. It will be filled with heart-warming photos and videos, and sweet video guestbook messages. When you’re ready, download your organized gallery in one click to any device.

Everyone will love how easy it is!

How it Works
Pricing

WHY BOTHER GUESTS WITH AN APP?

Instantly receive a custom QR code and private link that guests use to upload their best photos and memories in your digital gallery. Download everything in a click. Voila!

Only 2 mins to set up!

Get Started

What is guestpix?

GUESTPIX™ is your digital gallery that un-complicates the issue of receiving hundreds (or thousands) of photos, videos and guestbook messages from your guests, no matter what you’re celebrating.

Forget checking your chat apps, emails and SMS for photos then saving them all one at a time. The GUESTPIX™ photo sharing gallery and guestbook does all the hard work for you.

No App. No Fuss.

Just clever tech capturing your best memories!

You'll Enjoy...

1000s of photos & video

Collect unlimited photos & videos from guests from every angle. You’ll be excited to see your event through the eyes of your guests.

live slideshow

Activate the slideshow and watch as photos are automatically added after each rotation. It’s a fabulous way to showcase your celebration for all to enjoy!

guestbook

Receive written guestbook messages, reviews or testimonials. It’s the perfect accompaniment to your photo collection no matter what type of event you’re hosting.

video guestbook

The video guestbook is an interactive way to collect video messages from your event! Receive these in a segmented gallery.

QR code, private link & pin

Your custom QR code is your ticket to receiving content from guests. Add it to invitations, table cards, signage and more! Or send your private link (with PIN) digitally.

50+ Canva templates

Receive links to 50+ Canva templates to edit and print locally with your QR code. Includes welcome sign, table cards, mini take-home cards and I Spy game.

digital gallery

Enjoy the convenience of your own digital gallery. View photos, videos and guestbook messages, edit content and enjoy sharing with your guests.

zip download

Ready to download your event gallery? Everything is neatly zipped and ready to download within 12 months of your event. It’s the perfect way to keep, share or print photos no matter your event.

Design Themes

GUESTPIX™ now offers 15 stunning new design themes for Large and X-Large digital galleries.

Whether you’re hosting birthdays, baby showers, or religious ceremonies, these fresh designs let you customize your gallery to match your event’s unique style. 

You handle the guest list. We'll capture their best moments.

HOW MANY GUESTS AT YOUR CELEBRATION?

See pricing tiers.
Get Started

What Our Customers Are Saying!

"Yay!! Thank you! So glad it is available in Mexico! Wow! A few of my friends suggested other apps but I'm going with you guys for life! Everyone loved it at the party and we will continue in Mexico. Thank you so much, you're amazing, and VERY helpful! You rock!!! Thank you, thank you, thank you!"

Tyawnna - Mexico

August 2024

"I’m so beyond grateful we decided to do this. I literally set it up the day before and so many guests used it. Everyone said it was easy to use and several people mentioned what a great idea it was. 1000% would purchase again!!!"

Katie - USA

October 2024

"I investigated many sites that promised a way to capture photos. Many of these charged a large amount of money or didn't have the features I was looking for. I came across GUESTPIX and after researching decided to go with them. I was not disappointed. It was inexpensive and has so many features. 611 pictures, 43 videos, and numerous messages left. The customer service is amazing - they promptly responded to my email questions. If you are looking for a way to capture special photos - please do not hesitate to use GUESTPIX."

Kathleen - USA

February 2024

"I set this up as an alternative to a big photo booth, put the QR code on the tables and everyone loved it! It made it so easy to share all photos, not just in the booth area, but saved effort and costs and I didn't get left with distributing tons of photos 🙂 Win win!"

Tony - USA

October 2022

It's the simplest photo sharing site made for you and your guests.
